policy.computation: Reported separately; never substitutes for reach or holding acceptance.
policy.objective: Raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked.
policy.rule: Joint acceptance first; otherwise componentwise physical comparison.
policy.tradeoff: Any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not overall improvement.

coverage.definition: Both endpoints, timestamps aligned to task sample_period_s; missing samples are unavailable, never a pass.

duration.definition: Final closed interval [task duration - window, task duration].

position.definition: Maximum sampled world tip position error in the final interval.

speed.definition: Maximum sampled world tip translational speed norm in the final interval.
Euclidean norm of tip-site translational Jacobian times recorded backend qvel, reconstructed with sealed robot.xml and qpos; no finite differencing

terminal.definition: Euclidean world tip position error at the final execution sample; sealed evaluate.reach is the outcome authority.

control_period.definition: Simulated control spacing; synchronous wall overruns do not imply skipped applied updates or injected actuator delay.

duration.definition: Simulated task horizon, separate from computation wall time.

timing.interpretation: Applied updates, initialization selections, simulated duration and measured wall time are separate facts.

change_evidence: finished scoped delivery; do not spend unused budgets

chronology.ordering_authority: Store reservation and completion event sequence
chronology.scope: Real executions in this campaign store; imported records are historical evidence, not new attempts

semantics.latest_complete_result: Latest full profiled evaluation with retained bound facts, by profile completion event
semantics.latest_completed_evaluation: Latest official evaluation completion event; does not imply acceptance or complete profiling
semantics.latest_execution: Latest attempted simulation by reservation event; may be failed/incomplete

scope.material_qualification: Numerical Young-modulus scenarios, not experimentally identified materials; source-relative factors baseline 1, compliant 0.9, stiff 1.1. Density and viscosity remain fixed.
scope.source: Milestone 4 current-stage development scope; historical multiphysics profile remains unchanged

diagnosis.numerical_gap: Local controller comparisons require separately bound adoption and saved-horizon prerequisites; no such grant installed in this scheduling context.

question.current_question: Choose the next legal decision from updated bound feedback, including recorded matching repeats.
question.frozen_pre_experiment_question: What affordable evidence could distinguish observed holding-response differences on the shortened compliant geometry from solver-plan selection, weight interaction or structural sensitivity? The saved .075/.09/.10 holding values all fail speed with decreasing maxima; 0/.05 and .05/.05 both pass. Sparse samples do not establish a boundary, monotonicity, repetition or a dominant cause.

unresolved: Whether solver-plan selection, weight interaction, or structural sensitivity dominates the shortened-compliant holding-speed response remains undetermined; no numerical saved-state route is installed.

The existence, location and monotonicity of a holding-speed acceptance boundary between the passing (0/0.05, 0.05/0.05) and failing (0.075/0.05, 0.09/0.05, 0.09/0.075) samples is unknown from sparse single-run samples.
Run-to-run repetition/variance of the holding metrics is unmeasured, so observed differences may not be reproducible.

limitations: One matching repeat does not establish general repeatability, variance, identical trajectories or identical timing.
Sampled acceptance does not establish a continuous-time guarantee, realtime, superiority or a unique physical cause.
